sumOp ks c (sumOp ls d f) = fun (e : ℤ) => ∑ k ∈ ks, ∑ l ∈ ls, RamifiedShiftCalculus.shiftOp (k + l) (fun (e : ℤ) => c k e * d l (e + k)) f e
